_extraction_notes.revenue_line_mapping: Oracle's GAAP income statement reports four revenue lines: 'Cloud services and license support' (combined cloud services + on-premise license support), 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (new license revenue), 'Hardware', and 'Services'. In this schema they are mapped as revenue.cloud = 'Cloud services and license support' and revenue.software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license', using Oracle's own reported figures verbatim (no re-allocation or estimation).
_extraction_notes.capex_sign_convention: capex_quarter and capex figures are stored as positive magnitudes (spend), consistent with the source press releases' Free Cash Flow tables. free_cash_flow_quarter = operating_cash_flow_quarter - capex_quarter.
_extraction_notes.tax_sign_convention: tax_provision is stored as a signed P&L effect: negative for a provision (expense), positive for a benefit. Oracle's FY2023 exhibits print the tax line with inconsistent sign presentation across quarters (Q1 and Q3 print the provision as a positive number under 'Provision for income taxes'; Q2 prints it in parentheses under '(Provision for) benefit from income taxes'; Q4 prints a positive $210M under 'Benefit from (provision for) income taxes'). All four were normalized so that net_income = pretax_income + tax_provision. Q4 FY2023 is a genuine tax BENEFIT of $210M (GAAP effective rate of (6.7%) per the exhibit's footnote), so tax_provision is +210 for that quarter. non_gaap.reconciling_items.tax_effect_of_adjustments is the incremental tax on the non-GAAP adjustments (negative = additional tax), such that non_gaap.net_income_common = pretax_income + sum(pre-tax adjustments) + tax_provision + tax_effect_of_adjustments.
_extraction_notes.quarterly_cash_flow_derivation: Oracle's Q2, Q3, and Q4 (and full-year) press releases present GAAP cash flow statements on a year-to-date (cumulative fiscal-year) basis, not discrete-quarter. Discrete quarterly operating cash flow and capex for Q2-Q4 were derived by subtracting the prior cumulative period (from the prior quarter's own 8-K Exhibit 99.1) from the current cumulative period, both sourced from Oracle's own SEC filings. Q1 figures are reported directly on a discrete 3-month basis. Cross-check: sum of the four derived/reported quarterly operating cash flows (6,394+849+4,275+5,647=17,165) equals the FY2023 full-year GAAP operating cash flow of $17,165M exactly; sum of quarterly capex (1,719+2,435+2,628+1,913=8,695) equals FY2023 full-year capex of $8,695M exactly; and the resulting FY free cash flow of $8,470M matches the Free Cash Flow - Trailing 4-Quarters table printed in the Q4 exhibit ($8,470M) exactly. Each quarter's trailing-4-quarter OCF and capex in the exhibits' FCF tables (Q1 $10,542M/$5,168M; Q2 $15,073M/$6,678M; Q3 $15,503M/$8,205M; Q4 $17,165M/$8,695M) was also reproduced from FY2022 full-year figures and the prior-year cumulative columns, validating the derivation.
_extraction_notes.da_derivation: Depreciation and amortization of intangible assets are taken from the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income to net cash provided by operating activities' section of each exhibit's Condensed Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows. Q1 is a discrete 3-month figure; Q2-Q4 discrete figures were derived by subtracting the prior quarter's cumulative (6-, 9-month) figures from the current cumulative figures, with the as-printed cumulative amounts preserved in da.cumulative_as_printed. Cross-checks: derived quarterly amortization equals the 'Amortization of intangible assets' line on each quarter's discrete three-month income statement (919/907/886/870) in all four quarters; quarterly depreciation sums (547+591+672+716) to the FY2023 figure of $2,526M and quarterly amortization sums (919+907+886+870) to the FY2023 figure of $3,582M exactly.
_extraction_notes.rpo_disclosure: None of Oracle's four FY2023 Exhibit 99.1 earnings press releases mentions Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) anywhere in the text or tables (verified by full-text search of each exhibit for 'remaining performance' and 'performance obligation'). rpo.total and rpo.yoy_change are therefore null for every FY2023 quarter; no value was estimated or taken from any other document.
_extraction_notes.guidance_disclosure: Oracle's Exhibit 99.1 earnings press releases for Q1-Q4 FY2023 do not contain a quantified forward-guidance table (no next-quarter revenue growth %, cloud growth %, or non-GAAP EPS range). Quantified guidance of this kind is given verbally on the earnings conference call (a separate document, not part of this 8-K exhibit) and was NOT extracted here to preserve strict SEC-filing sourcing. Each quarter's guidance_issued._note quotes the qualitative forward-looking commentary and any references to prior guidance that do appear in the exhibit.
_extraction_notes.cerner_acquisition: Oracle closed its acquisition of Cerner Corporation in June 2022, so FY2023 is the first fiscal year consolidating Cerner. Each exhibit states Cerner's contribution to total revenues (Q1 $1.4B; Q2 $1.5B; Q3 $1.5B; Q4 $1.5B; FY2023 $5.9B) in the press-release text, and the acquisition is visible in the statements as printed: cash-flow line 'Acquisitions, net of cash acquired' of $(27,798)M (three months ended Aug 31, 2022), $(27,799)M (six months), $(27,721)M (nine months) and $(27,721)M (fiscal year); balance-sheet 'Intangible assets, net' rising from $1,440M at May 31, 2022 to $12,499M at Aug 31, 2022 and 'Goodwill, net' from $43,811M to $61,629M; and the GAAP operating-expense line 'Acquisition related and other' ($41M/$62M/$37M/$51M by quarter; $190M FY2023). These as-printed items are recorded per quarter in acquisition_related_as_printed. Note that the prior-year comparative 'Acquisition related and other' figures in the Q2/Q3/Q4 exhibits ($4,667M for the three months ended Nov 30, 2021; $4,713M for FY2022) include $4.7B of litigation related charges unrelated to Cerner, per Oracle's footnote; those FY2022 comparatives are not part of this FY2023 dataset.
_extraction_notes.quarterly_vs_annual_rounding: Oracle's exhibits footnote that 'the sum of the quarterly information presented may vary from the year-to-date information presented due to rounding.' Sums of the four discrete quarters differ from the Year Ended May 31, 2023 column by $1M for total revenues (49,955 vs 49,954), 'Cloud services and license support' revenue (35,308 vs 35,307), operating income (13,094 vs 13,093), net income (8,504 vs 8,503) and non-GAAP net income (14,177 vs 14,176). The annual record uses the Year Ended May 31, 2023 column exactly as printed; each quarter uses its own discrete three-month column exactly as printed. Cash-flow and D&A quarterly sums reconcile to the annual figures exactly.
_extraction_notes.preferred_dividends: Oracle has no preferred stock outstanding in FY2023; preferred_dividends is 0 in all periods and net_income_common equals net_income.
_extraction_notes.stockholders_equity_sign: Oracle reported a stockholders' DEFICIT (negative equity) at Aug 31, 2022, Nov 30, 2022 and Feb 28, 2023, captioned 'Stockholders' Deficit' in those exhibits, and positive 'Stockholders' Equity (Deficit)' of $1,556M at May 31, 2023. balance_sheet.stockholders_equity records the sign exactly as printed.
_extraction_notes.exhibit_file_names: The Q1-Q3 FY2023 exhibits were filed under the file name orcl-ex991_6.htm (not orcl-ex99_1.htm); the Q4 FY2023 exhibit is orcl-ex99_1.htm. All were retrieved directly from SEC EDGAR at the URLs recorded in each source block.
